description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2590016106726 BRACKET,VEHICULAR COMP: Line 0001 Qty 87 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0069 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
